subject: Registration confirmed: $event_name
body:
Dear $full_name,

Your registration for the following alumni event is confirmed. We look forward to seeing you there!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EVENT REGISTRATION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Event:           $event_name
Date & Time:     $event_date
Location:        $location
Fee:             $fee
Payment Method:  $payment_method

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If you need to cancel or change your registration, please do so through the Alumni Portal or contact the Alumni Relations team.

Warm regards,
The Alumni Relations Team
